categories.name: 前沿论文
categories.commentary: 这批论文集中在多步检索与多Agent推理的训练方法、推理效率优化，以及评测结论的可信度审计三条线上。

articles.title: ClueFlow: Learning Long-Horizon Search through Attributed Research-State Transitions
articles.zh: ClueFlow：通过带属性的研究状态转移学习长程搜索
articles.summary: 如果你在做长程检索或多步研究型Agent，这篇把"研究过程"显式建模成带属性的状态转移来学习，值得看它怎么定义状态空间和转移。
articles.author: Yicheng Wang, Wentao Tan 等
articles.body: Long-horizon search requires agents to acquire relevant evidence and integrate it into an evolving research state. Existing methods maintain research states to guide exploration or assign turn-level progress signals, yet grounding these signals in explicit, attributable state changes remains underexplored. We introduce ClueFlow, which learns long-horizon search from attributed research-state transitions. ClueFlow constructs Source-State-Final attribution chains that connect evidence-acquiring browser actions, Evidence and Candidate updates, and the final answer supported by those updates. During search, ClueFlow records typed state changes and potentially supporting browser actions, then applies gold-conditioned semantic validation and source tracing after execution. We use this attribution to guide both supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning. During SFT, attribution selects which decisions receive supervision with their original interaction contexts. During Turn-PPO, the same attribution augments outcome-based turn advantages with credit assigned along the Source-State-Final chains. Transition-level validation also recovers useful supervision from gold-consistent state changes in trajectories with incorrect final answers. We evaluate ClueFlow across two Qwen backbones and four search benchmarks spanning live-web and fixed-corpus settings, observing consistent gains from SFT and further improvements from PPO. With Qwen3.5-35B-A3B, ClueFlow achieves 60.0% accuracy on BrowseComp and 72.0% on BrowseComp-Plus. In controlled BrowseComp-Plus experiments, attribution-guided SFT matches all-turn exact-context SFT using about 30% of the training tokens, while attribution-guided PPO outperforms outcome-only PPO by 4.1 pp. These results demonstrate that state-transition attribution enables efficient supervision and effective credit assignment for long-horizon search agents.
articles.bodyZh: 长程搜索（long-horizon search）要求智能体（agents）先找到相关证据，再把它整合进一个不断更新的研究状态（research state）里。现有方法会维护研究状态来指导探索，或者给出轮级进度信号（turn-level progress signals），但怎么把这些信号真正落到明确、可归因的状态变化上，研究得还不够。我们提出 ClueFlow，它从可归因的研究状态转移（attributed research-state transitions）中学习长程搜索。ClueFlow 会构建“来源-状态-最终答案”归因链（Source-State-Final attribution chains），把获取证据的浏览器操作、证据和候选更新（Evidence and Candidate updates），以及由这些更新支撑的最终答案串起来。搜索过程中，ClueFlow 会记录带类型的状态变化（typed state changes）和可能起支撑作用的浏览器操作，执行完后再做以标准答案为条件的语义验证（gold-conditioned semantic validation）和来源追踪（source tracing）。我们用这种归因来指导监督微调（supervised fine-tuning, SFT）和强化学习（reinforcement learning）。在 SFT 阶段，归因会挑出哪些决策要带着原始交互上下文接受监督。在 Turn-PPO（轮级近端策略优化）阶段，同一套归因会把信用（credit）沿着“来源-状态-最终答案”链分配，用来增强基于结果的轮级优势（outcome-based turn advantages）。转移级验证（transition-level validation）还能从最终答案不正确、但状态变化与标准答案一致（gold-consistent）的轨迹里，捞回有用的监督信号。我们在两个 Qwen 骨干模型（backbones）和四个搜索基准测试（benchmarks）上评估 ClueFlow，覆盖实时网络（live-web）和固定语料库（fixed-corpus）两种设置；结果看到 SFT 带来稳定提升，PPO 又进一步提升。用 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 时，ClueFlow 在 BrowseComp 上达到 60.0% 准确率，在 BrowseComp-Plus 上达到 72.0%。在受控的 BrowseComp-Plus 实验中，归因引导的 SFT 只用了约 30% 的训练 token，就追平了全轮次精确上下文 SFT（all-turn exact-context SFT）；而归因引导的 PPO 比只看结果的 PPO（outcome-only PPO）高出 4.1 个百分点（pp）。这些结果表明，状态转移归因（state-transition attribution）能让长程搜索智能体获得高效监督和有效信用分配（credit assignment）。

articles.title: GraphEvoResearcher: Graph-Aware Training-Free Self-Reflective Reasoning for Cost-Bounded Multi-Hop Question Answering
articles.zh: GraphEvoResearcher：面向成本受限多跳问答的图感知免训练自反思推理
articles.summary: 如果你要落多跳问答又不想再训模型，这套图感知+自反思的免训练方案能在成本上限内做推理，省的是训练成本，推理开销还得自己算。
articles.author: Suxing Liu
articles.body: Multi-hop question answering (QA) requires models to chain intermediate conclusions while remaining cost-aware. Existing training-free self-reflective protocols (generate -> critique -> revise) improve accuracy but operate on a flat token stream: revisions cannot identify which prior step is unreliable, and early stopping cannot exploit structural convergence. We introduce GraphEvoResearcher, a training-free protocol that lifts EvoResearcher's self-reflective meta-reward onto an explicit reasoning graph - nodes are intermediate conclusions/evidence and edges encode support, contradict, and depends_on. A graph-aware meta-reward combines correctness, efficiency, reflection, diversity, and four structural signals (connectivity, acyclicity, branch coverage, path convergence) to decide whether to revise, backtrack, or stop. A graph-convergence early-stop terminates when evidence branches converge on a single conclusion. On a real LLM (DeepSeek), over GSM8K, MATH, and BBH (n=50 each), GraphEvoResearcher reaches 98%, 92%, and 82% respectively, the highest of all baselines, with the largest gains on the hardest set (MATH: +24 pp over single-shot, +12 pp over flat reflection), while keeping construction cost bounded at ~2 steps / 4.5-5 nodes. Our results indicate the structural signal of a reasoning graph is most valuable exactly where single-step reasoning is unreliable.
articles.bodyZh: 多跳问答（QA）要求模型把中间结论一环扣一环地串起来，同时还不能不顾成本。现有的免训练自反思流程（generate -> critique -> revise，即生成→批判→修订）能提升准确率，但它是在一条扁平的 token 流上操作：修订时说不清前面哪一步不可靠，提前停止也没法利用结构上的收敛。我们提出 GraphEvoResearcher，这是一种免训练流程，把 EvoResearcher 的自反思元奖励（self-reflective meta-reward）提升到一张显式的推理图（reasoning graph）上——节点是中间结论或证据，边表示支持（support）、矛盾（contradict）和依赖（depends_on）。一个图感知元奖励（graph-aware meta-reward）把正确性、效率、反思、多样性，以及四个结构信号（连通性（connectivity）、无环性（acyclicity）、分支覆盖率（branch coverage）、路径收敛（path convergence））合在一起，来决定是该修订、回溯还是停止。图收敛提前停止（graph-convergence early-stop）会在证据分支收敛到同一个结论时终止。在真实的大语言模型（LLM，DeepSeek）上，在 GSM8K、MATH 和 BBH 上（每组 n=50），GraphEvoResearcher 分别达到 98%、92% 和 82%，是所有基线里最高的，而且在最难的集合上提升最大（MATH：比单次作答（single-shot）高 24 个百分点，比平面反思（flat reflection）高 12 个百分点），同时把构建成本控制在约 2 步 / 4.5-5 个节点。我们的结果表明，推理图的结构信号，恰恰在单步推理不可靠的地方最有价值。

articles.title: On the Benefits of Uncertainty Estimation for Species Classification: A Case Study on Optimizing Expert re-Annotation
articles.zh: 不确定性估计对物种分类的收益：以优化专家重新标注为例
articles.summary: 如果你在做细粒度分类、又要为专家标注掏钱，这篇说明不确定性估计能帮你挑出最值得返工重标的那批样本。
articles.author: Kamenan N'Gadi, Martin Laviale 等
articles.body: Automated identification of diatoms from microscopic images is a cornerstone of large-scale freshwater biomonitoring, yet the high diversity of species and strong class imbalance pose significant challenges for reliable classification. In this study, we develop a ResNet-18 baseline for a 759-class diatom dataset and investigate how calibrated confidence estimates support selective classification to reduce expert workload without sacrificing taxonomic integrity. While the initial model exhibits overconfidence with an Expected Calibration Error (ECE) of 0.117, post-hoc temperature scaling (T = 2.12) dramatically improves reliability, lowering the ECE to 0.055.By leveraging these calibrated probabilities within a triage framework, we demonstrate that a Selective Macro-F1 score of 99.01% can be maintained at 66.2% coverage (rejection threshold $τ$ = 0.934). Qualitative analysis reveals that the system effectively functions as an intelligent filter, consistently deferring rare taxa-such as AAMB and AASI-and ambiguous morphologies for expert review. Our findings, supported by the torch-uncertainty framework, highlight the potential of simple calibration techniques to make automated diatom identification practical and robust, prioritizing the preservation of rare species metrics essential for ecological assessment. To support reproducibility, our code, environment specifications, and calibration results are available anonymously at https://anonymous.4open. science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README.
articles.bodyZh: 从显微图像里自动识别硅藻，是大规模淡水生物监测的一块基石，但硅藻物种多样性太高、类别又严重不平衡，想做到可靠分类并不容易。这项研究里，我们针对一个 759 类的硅藻数据集，搭建了一个 ResNet-18 基线模型，并研究校准后的置信度估计（calibrated confidence estimates）如何支撑选择性分类（selective classification），从而在不牺牲分类学完整性的前提下减少专家工作量。初始模型有点过度自信，期望校准误差（Expected Calibration Error, ECE）是 0.117；做了事后温度缩放（post-hoc temperature scaling，T = 2.12）之后，可靠性明显提升，ECE 降到了 0.055。把这些校准后的概率放进分诊框架（triage framework）里用，我们证明：在 66.2% 的覆盖率（拒绝阈值 τ = 0.934）下，仍能保持 99.01% 的选择性宏平均 F1（Selective Macro-F1）分数。定性分析发现，这套系统实际上就像一个智能过滤器，会稳定地把稀有类群——比如 AAMB 和 AASI——以及形态模棱两可的样本，交给专家复核。我们的发现得到 torch-uncertainty 框架支持，说明简单校准技术有潜力让自动硅藻识别变得实用又稳健，而且优先保住了生态评估中必不可少的稀有物种指标。为了支持可复现性，我们的代码、环境说明和校准结果都匿名公开在：https://anonymous.4open.science/r/greenprwksp-B53D/README。

articles.title: Correctness-Dependent Asymmetric Target Distributions for Self-Distillation Policy Optimization
articles.zh: 自蒸馏策略优化中依赖正确性的非对称目标分布
articles.summary: 如果你在调 self-distillation 或策略优化，这篇提醒目标分布该按答案对错做非对称处理，对学生信号一刀切会浪费掉正负样本的区分度。
articles.author: Suwan Yoon, Seongryong Jung 等
articles.body: Self-distillation policy optimization provides dense token-level supervision for LLM post-training through feedback-conditioned self-teachers. However, directly matching the self-teacher can disrupt successful behaviors on correct rollouts while providing insufficient correction on incorrect ones. We propose Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation (APSD), which constructs correctness-dependent targets by mixing student and self-teacher distributions: interpolation preserves successful behaviors on correct rollouts, while extrapolation beyond the self-teacher strengthens correction on incorrect ones. We analyze APSD through divergence decomposition, reverse-KL barycentric geometry, and gradient analysis, highlighting the importance of gradient flow through student-dependent targets. Experiments under reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards and rich feedback show that APSD achieves strong overall performance against reinforcement-learning and self-distillation baselines and matches SDPO performance with 2.6x fewer training steps on average across Qwen3 model scales.
articles.bodyZh: 自蒸馏策略优化（Self-distillation policy optimization）能给大语言模型后训练（LLM post-training）提供密集的 token 级监督，靠的是一套会根据反馈来当“自我老师”的机制。但问题是，如果直接去对齐这个自我老师，模型在答对的采样轨迹（rollouts）上原本做得好的行为可能被搅乱，而在答错的轨迹上，纠偏又不够狠。于是我们提出了基于自蒸馏的非对称策略优化（Asymmetric Policy Optimization via Self-Distillation，APSD）：它把学生模型和自我老师的分布按“答对还是答错”混起来，构造出不同的目标分布——答对时用插值（interpolation），把已经成功的行为保住；答错时则往外推，做超出自我老师的外推（extrapolation），把纠错力度加强。我们还从散度分解（divergence decomposition）、反向 KL 重心几何（reverse-KL barycentric geometry）和梯度分析（gradient analysis）三个角度拆解了 APSD，并特别说明：让梯度流（gradient flow）经过依赖学生模型的目标（student-dependent targets）很关键。在带可验证奖励的强化学习（reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards）和丰富反馈（rich feedback）条件下做的实验显示，APSD 对上强化学习和自蒸馏这些基线时整体表现很强，而且在 Qwen3 各规模模型上，平均只用 SDPO 大约 1/2.6 的训练步数，就能达到和 SDPO 相当的表现。

articles.title: GLOBE: Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit via Unit-Sphere Trajectories
articles.zh: GLOBE：基于单位球轨迹的几何引导在线行为早退
articles.summary: 如果你关心推理加速或早退机制，这篇用单位球上的轨迹几何判断何时停，比单纯按置信度阈值早退更有依据。
articles.author: Xinyue Peng, Zhenlin Liang 等
articles.body: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve problem solving, but models often keep generating after the correct answer is already reachable; the extra steps raise serving costs and may replace a correct intermediate result with an incorrect one. We propose GLOBE (Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit), an online, training-free algorithm that terminates the model's CoT process early. GLOBE embeds each completed reasoning segment as a point on a unit sphere and reads the shape of the resulting semantic trajectory. GLOBE first applies a trial phase that generates short trial answers in a separate branch, stopping the main stream on an accepted trial after checking confidence against a threshold. If generation continues, a trajectory phase stops the stream once this path repeatedly reverses direction with little net progress. On five benchmarks including mathematical reasoning, tool calling, and agent memory, GLOBE cuts output tokens by 49.7% and active end-to-end wall time (E2E) by 51.0% across two models, and achieves a five-task average of 80.58%, comparable to Full CoT.
articles.bodyZh: 思维链（Chain-of-thought, CoT）推理确实能让模型更会解题，但问题是，模型常常在正确答案其实已经够得着之后还继续往下生成；多出来的步骤会抬高服务成本，还可能把原本正确的中间结果给带偏成错误。为此，我们提出 GLOBE（Geometry-Led Online Behavioral Early Exit），这是一种在线、免训练的算法，能让模型的 CoT 过程提前收尾。GLOBE 会把每一段已完成的推理片段嵌入成单位球面上的一个点，再去看整条语义轨迹呈现什么形状。它先跑一个试跑阶段：在单独分支里生成简短的试答，拿置信度去对阈值检查，一旦试答通过，就把主流程停掉。如果生成还得继续，就进入轨迹阶段：只要这条路径反复掉头、净进展又很小，就把生成流停掉。在数学推理、工具调用、智能体记忆等五个基准测试上，GLOBE 在两个模型上把输出 token 数砍掉 49.7%，把端到端实际耗时（active end-to-end wall time, E2E）降低 51.0%，五项任务平均达到 80.58%，和完整思维链（Full CoT）差不多。

articles.title: Reconstruction and Discrete-Event Simulation Assessment of an Analytical
articles.zh: 一个分析模型的重构与离散事件仿真评估（原题在 arXiv 上被截断）
articles.summary: 如果你不是本来就熟悉这个方向，标题残缺到这个程度，先花一分钟扫摘要和图表再决定要不要点开。
articles.author: Mohsen Reda Mahmoud Moursi, Ahmed Stohy
articles.body: This article presents an analytical-DES benchmark for intra-aisle robotic picking in automated warehousing. The investigated cycle combines horizontal shuttle travel, tote handling and item picking at storage locations. Simulation results are compared with the analytical formulation of Lerher et al. under the same rack geometry, shuttle-motion, handling and picking conditions, and the same definitions of cycle time and derived item throughput. Reproducing the published analytical tables requires the distance interpretation dES = 1.5 m and dTB = 0 m. The analytical-DES benchmark comprises 180 scenarios formed from three rack lengths, two paired motion profiles and n = 1 to 30 visited picking locations, with ten simulation replications per scenario. The six n = 1 cases are reported separately because no travel-between component is present. Across the remaining 174 scenarios, the mean absolute relative cycle-time discrepancy is 0.8655%, the median is 0.6758%, and the maximum is 7.0370%. The mean absolute error is 2.411 s and the RMSE is 2.744 s. The simulated scenario-mean cycle time is below the analytical value in all 174 principal scenarios. The results therefore show close numerical correspondence under the tested conditions, but not exact agreement, formal statistical equivalence, or validation against an operating warehouse.
articles.bodyZh: 这篇文章给自动化仓储里的巷道内机器人拣选（intra-aisle robotic picking）提供了一个“解析模型—离散事件仿真（DES）”对比基准。研究的作业循环包括穿梭车水平行走、料箱搬运（tote handling），以及在储位处拣货。仿真结果会和 Lerher 等人提出的解析公式做对比，前提是货架几何、穿梭车运动、搬运和拣选条件都一样，周期时间（cycle time）以及由此推导出的物品吞吐量（item throughput）的定义也一样。要复现论文里已经发表的解析表，需要把距离解释成 dES = 1.5 米、dTB = 0 米。这个解析-DES 基准一共包含 180 个情景，由三种货架长度、两种成对的运动曲线（motion profiles），以及 n = 1 到 30 个被访问拣选位组合而成，每个情景做 10 次仿真重复。n = 1 的六个情形单独报告，因为这种情况下不存在点位之间的行走（travel-between）部分。在剩下的 174 个情景里，周期时间的平均绝对相对偏差是 0.8655%，中位数是 0.6758%，最大值是 7.0370%。平均绝对误差是 2.411 秒，均方根误差（RMSE）是 2.744 秒。在这 174 个主要情景里，仿真的情景平均周期时间都低于解析值。所以，结果说明在测试条件下两者数值上很接近，但并不是完全一致，也不能说已经达到正式的统计等价，更没有拿实际运营中的仓库来验证。

articles.title: Behavioral Probes for Information Flow in LLM Swarms
articles.zh: LLM 集群中信息流动的行为探针
articles.summary: 如果你在做多 Agent 系统，这套行为探针能帮你查信息到底在 Agent 之间怎么传、在哪一环断了或被污染。
articles.author: Junhui Chen, Yu Zhang 等
articles.body: Most existing approaches to LLM swarm optimization are utility-driven, focusing on final task utility while leaving the processing, integration, and reliance of information within individual interactions largely implicit. To address this, we study LLM swarm interactions from an information-flow-based view and introduce behavioral probes to quantify information flow patterns. Specifically, we repurpose External Context Score (ECS) and Parametric Knowledge Score (PKS)---originally designed for hallucination analysis---to measure a node's external-context dependence and parametric-knowledge dependence, respectively. Across controlled and realistic swarm settings, we observe consistent patterns: ECS increases with input relevance and distinguishes useful multi-source contributions, while PKS decreases as informative context accumulates. Building on this heuristic interpretation, we demonstrate how these probes can complement utility-driven structure optimization in two controlled applications. Probe-guided node pruning reduces redundant communication and token consumption, and probe-guided reasoning-path search accelerates convergence compared to utility-only baselines. Our empirical results suggest that behavioral probes can make the internal information flow of LLM swarms observable and serve as effective auxiliary signals for structure optimization.
articles.bodyZh: 现在大多数做 LLM swarm optimization（大语言模型群体优化）的方法都是效用驱动的，眼睛主要盯着最终任务效用，至于每次交互里信息怎么处理、怎么整合、又有多依赖，基本都没明说。为了解决这个问题，我们从基于信息流的视角来研究 LLM 群体交互，并引入 behavioral probes（行为探针）来量化信息流模式。具体来说，我们把原本用来分析幻觉的 External Context Score（外部上下文得分，ECS）和 Parametric Knowledge Score（参数知识得分，PKS）拿来改造，分别衡量一个节点对外部上下文的依赖程度，以及对参数知识的依赖程度。在受控环境和真实群体设置里，我们都看到了比较一致的模式：ECS 会随着输入相关性上升而上升，并且能把有用的多源贡献区分出来；而 PKS 则会随着有信息量的上下文不断积累而下降。基于这种启发式解释，我们在两个受控应用里展示了这些探针怎么给效用驱动的结构优化打辅助。探针引导的节点剪枝能减少多余通信和 token 消耗；探针引导的推理路径搜索，跟只看效用的基线相比，也能让收敛更快。我们的实证结果表明，行为探针可以让 LLM 群体内部的信息流变得可观测，也能作为结构优化的有效辅助信号。

articles.title: Token-Set Choice Confounds POPE: A Systematic Audit of Yes/No Extraction in VLM Hallucination Evaluation
articles.zh: Token 集合选择混淆 POPE：VLM 幻觉评测中 Yes/No 抽取的系统性审计
articles.summary: 如果你拿 POPE 分数当 VLM 幻觉能力的硬指标，这篇会告诉你光是 Yes/No 怎么抽取就足以把结论带偏，跨论文比分数前先对齐抽取方式。
articles.author: Kesav Kumar Jayakumar, Karthigeyan Thilak
articles.body: We set out to reproduce a recent hallucination-mitigation result on the POPE benchmark. The LLaVA-1.5-7B baseline we measured, 82.21 F1 on the adversarial split, sat 1.21 to 8.67 points above the adversarial baselines we planned to compare against (81.00, 79.30, and 73.54). We looked at the evaluation code and found a readout choice that moves F1 on its own. A two-token logit readout decides yes versus no by comparing two vocabulary IDs, 3582 ("yes") and 1217 ("no"). Across 9,000 greedy-decode questions spanning all three splits, neither ID is generated even once. The model emits " Yes" (token 3869) and " No" (token 1939), because SentencePiece prepends a space byte after the prompt suffix "ASSISTANT:". Read with an eight-token lookup that covers the space-prefixed surface forms, LLaVA-1.5-7B scores F1 0.8221, 0.8498, and 0.8713 on the adversarial, popular, and random splits. That 6.13-point adversarial shift exceeds the adversarial gain reported by five of the six papers we surveyed. None of them states its readout, and our reference ran under 4-bit NF4 quantization, so we cannot say how much of any reported gain a matched evaluation would keep. That comparison stays unresolved until readout and precision are matched. On the fixed baseline we run nine inference-time corrections of our own (none beat it) and dissect why the adversarial split resists logit-level intervention. In a 3,000-question probe, wrong predictions draw more image attention than correct ones (Cohen's $d=-0.46$, $p=1.4\times10^{-24}$), the opposite of what grounding-based corrections assume. A four-readout audit across four further VLMs from three tokenizer families confirms the confound is protocol-level, not model-specific: porting the LLaVA-1.5 IDs verbatim drops F1 to 0.00 on the two disjoint-vocabulary models, whereas a tokenizer-derived readout holds between 0.80 and 0.92.
articles.bodyZh: 我们本来想复现一个最近在 POPE 基准（POPE benchmark）上的幻觉缓解（hallucination-mitigation）结果。我们测到的 LLaVA-1.5-7B 基线，在对抗子集（adversarial split）上的 F1 是 82.21，比我们原本打算对比的对抗基线（81.00、79.30 和 73.54）高了 1.21 到 8.67 分。我们回头看了评估代码，发现有一个判读方式（readout choice）自己就能让 F1 动起来。只用两个 token 的 logit 判读（logit readout），是靠比较两个词表 ID（vocabulary IDs）——3582（“yes”）和 1217（“no”）——来决定 yes 还是 no。可在覆盖三个子集、总共 9000 道贪心解码（greedy decode）题里，这两个 ID 一次都没被生成出来。模型实际吐的是“ Yes”（token 3869）和“ No”（token 1939），因为提示词后缀“ASSISTANT:”之后，SentencePiece 会先加一个空格字节。要是改用八个 token 的查找表，把带空格前缀的表面形式（surface forms）都覆盖进去，LLaVA-1.5-7B 在对抗子集、流行子集（popular split）和随机子集（random split）上的 F1 就分别是 0.8221、0.8498 和 0.8713。这个 6.13 分的对抗子集变化，已经超过我们调研的六篇论文里五篇报告的对抗收益。可它们都没说自己的判读方式，而我们的参考结果又是在 4-bit NF4 量化（4-bit NF4 quantization）下跑的，所以没法说评估条件对齐后，已报告的收益还能留下多少。在判读方式和精度没对齐之前，这个比较就悬着，没法下结论。在这个固定基线上，我们自己做了九种推理时校正（inference-time corrections），没有一种能打过它；然后我们拆解了为什么对抗子集这么抗 logit 层面的干预。在一个 3000 道题的探测实验里，错误预测反而比正确预测吸引了更多图像注意力（Cohen's d=-0.46，p=1.4×10^-24），这跟基于 grounding 的校正（grounding-based corrections）所假设的正好相反。我们又对另外四个 VLM（视觉语言模型）做了四种判读方式的审计，这些模型来自三个分词器家族（tokenizer families），结果确认这个混淆因素是协议层面的（protocol-level），不是某个模型特有的：把 LLaVA-1.5 的 ID 原样搬过去，两个词表不相交的模型（disjoint-vocabulary models）F1 直接掉到 0.00；而从分词器推导出来的判读方式（tokenizer-derived readout）则能保持在 0.80 到 0.92 之间。
